description: Conflict rule proposal events (RuleProposalEvent@v1) and hash-chained rulebook amendments (RulebookAmendment@v1)
gap: Same tree as the proposed conflict_ledger row (ps:data/conflicts): no backup admission or restore drill is measured. Owner must add data/conflicts to a real persistent-state backup source before decision writes are activated.
restore: Restore rule_proposals.jsonl and rulebook_amendments.jsonl together; both are sequence + sha256 hash chained and fail closed on a gap; the effective rulebook is rebuilt from config/conflict_rulebook.json plus the amendments.
